items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: There was several cats out there who played good trumpet, man. (?)Bobby Lee(?)...

ctx.x: tell you the truth, because you really don't be thinking in terms like that when somebody's playing. At least that's the way I was then, you know. All I know is she played good.
There was several cats out there who played good trumpet, man. (?)Bobby Lee(?)...
